g.text: Kao: who moved closer to the true count?
Each point pairs one person's initial private guess with their actual revised guess. The true count is 659 objects.
Revision can help, hurt, or leave the answer unchanged; no simulated people or rounds are included.
Kao et al. (2018) | doi.org/10.1098/rsif.2018.0130 | Data: figshare file 11094635 | 602 measured response pairs
All 602 pairs are plotted, including extreme guesses; overlapping dots can represent multiple people.
Counts use absolute error in objects. The log axes only make the full range of guesses visible.
The cue was experimentally constructed relative to each person's first guess. This is an observed cue-response experiment, not a live group discussion.
